title: Computer Vision II: Learning
description: Students without any of these prerequisites are advised to contact the instructor prior to taking the course. Advanced course in computer vision. Topics include convolutional networks and back-propagation, object and action recognition, self-supervised and few-shot learning, image synthesis and generative models, object tracking, vision and language, vision and audio, 3D representations, interpretability, and bias, ethics, and media deception
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: COMS W4731 ; Fundamentals of calculus, linear algebra, and Python programming.
raw_title_text: COMS W4732 Computer Vision II: Learning. 3.00 points .
